**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's core claim that the election was "rigged and stolen" closely echoes [T4-004524](#T4-004524), which reports that mainstream media were "saying the election is rigged" following a Comey/Weiner disclosure, sharing the rigging narrative but attributing it to media coverage rather than asserting it directly. [T4-004698](#T4-004698) is thematically adjacent, alleging a "tyrannical government protecting a crime syndicate" under an election-related hashtag, which parallels the new post's implication of illegitimate power but stops short of claiming votes were stolen. [T4-004672](#T4-004672) shares an election-integrity angle by asserting "The polls are FAKE!", a related but distinct grievance about polling rather than the count or outcome. Meaningful differences: [T4-004758](#T4-004758) frames the result as a "massive repudiation of the press," accepting the outcome rather than disputing it, while [T4-003959](#T4-003959) merely asks "Who will win the election?" with no integrity claim at all.
